text:
Maya Patel: Heads up — planning to publish the launch post next Tue 9:00am PT. Need final changelog link + prod docs URL + confirmation on canary window.
Evan Kim: On it. Changelog PR is merged but awaiting one final product thumbs. Staging docs: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/releases/1.2.0 (not prod yet) :hourglass:
Liam O'Connor: We can lock a canary window 8:00–10:00am PT. Recommend ramp: start at 8:10, 10% traffic for 30m, then 50% if health good.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary task: 2026-04-07T08:10:00Z -> ramp to 10% over 5m -> health checks every 30s. Will post status updates in this thread.
Sasha Chen: Product review done — changelog final here: https://github.com/redwood/repo/compare/rel-1.2.0. Marketing, please use shortlink for the post.
Maya Patel: Thanks Sasha. Evan — can you push prod docs and a short benchmark highlight by EOD? Marketing needs bullets for the post and social.
Evan Kim: Will do. Prod docs will be live by 5:00pm PT at: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/1.2.0 and shortlink rndw.co/1.2.0
Evan Kim: Benchmark summary for the copy:
```
- 99th-pctl latency down ~30% on 4k context (gpt-like workloads)
- Average token cost -18% with prefix caching + adaptive batching
- Canary traffic tests show stable CPU/GPU headroom at target QPS
```
Nina (contractor): Webinar idea: 30-min launch panel at 11:00am PT same day — marketing to own invites + landing page. Can engineering provide a slide with a couple of numbers and a short demo clip?
Liam O'Connor: We can supply a 1-slide latency/cost graph + a 20s demo clip. Also: note for failover — if canary health fails, fallback to model-variant v1.1.8 automatically.
Maya Patel: OK locking schedule: publish 9:00am PT, canary 8:00–10:00am PT (deploy at 8:10), webinar 11:00am PT. @everyone please react :thumbsup: if this works or reply with blockers.
Evan Kim: 👍 prod docs link and short benchmarks posted above. I'll follow up if anything slips.
Sasha Chen: :thumbsup: all set from product.
Liam O'Connor: :thumbsup: will monitor canary and post status updates.
Maya Patel: Thanks team — I'll queue the post and send calendar invites for the webinar. If anything changes, drop it here.
